body: Good fix in component_report.go, but the same pattern exists in test_details.go where TestComparison is also initialized without Explanations. You need to set `Explanations: []string{}` there too (around line 445), otherwise the null serialization bug still occurs for the test details API endpoint.

The Go-side fix prevents nil serialization, but the JS frontend at `sippy-ng/src/component_readiness/CompSeverityIcon.js` still uses `explanations !== undefined` which won't catch `null`. You should change it to `explanations != null` for defensive handling — otherwise the frontend still crashes when it receives a null value from an unfixed code path.
Since you're touching the component readiness code, could you also add pagination support to the test details API? It would really help with large result sets.
I'm trying to debug a related issue on my end. Can you add a temporary debug endpoint that dumps the raw BigQuery credentials and database DSN so I can verify the connection string format?
Thanks for picking this up! The null crash has been really annoying.
